title: what is 127 0 0 1 5000
linkedin:
what is 127 0 0 1 5000

> 127.0.0.1 is the loopback address, a reserved address that always means the machine you are on. Traffic sent there never reaches a network cable or a wifi radio. `localhost` is just a friendly name for the same thing.

Read the full guide: https://www.kloudbean.com/blog/what-is-127-0-0-1-5000/

#Kloudbean #CloudHosting #DevOps #WebDev
thread: > 127.0.0.1 is the loopback address, a reserved address that always means the machine you are on.
Traffic sent there never reaches a network cable or a wifi radio.
`localhost` is just a friendly name for the same thing.
The `:5000` is the port, which identifies which program on that machine should answer, and 5000 is the traditional default for Flask.
